content_sections.heading: BHEL Project Engineer Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: A total of 16 vacancies have been notified for the Project Engineer post under the Defence and Aerospace Business Group (DABG), ESD. The number of vacancies is tentative and may vary based on further assessment by BHEL. Reservation for Persons with Disability and Ex-servicemen will be applied as per Government of India directives, as specified in the official notification. PNB LBO Recruitment 2026 Last Date Extended - Apply Online for 545 Local Bank Officer Posts

content_sections.heading: BHEL Project Engineer Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must hold a Full-Time Degree in Electronics / Electrical / Instrumentation / Computer Science with at least 60% marks (50% for SC/ST candidates) or equivalent CGPA in aggregate of all years/semesters from a recognized University/Institution. In addition, candidates must have a minimum of 12 months of relevant post-qualification work experience, exclusive of any Trainee/Apprenticeship period. The notification lists the following essential skill areas: Basic knowledge of Control Systems Familiarity with various communication protocols Testing & commissioning of Control Systems Minimum 12 months of experience in Erection & Commissioning supervision Ability to read Drawings, Electrical Schematics, Wiring Charts, and Hook-up Drawings Ability to handle test instruments such as Calibrator, Analog & Digital Multimeter Willingness to work on-board Naval ships in staggered shifts, Pan-India Good communication skills to independently handle customers Desirable qualifications include prior experience with Control System Hardware and System Engineering, Shipboard Propulsion Control Systems, Power Management Systems, Auxiliary Control Systems, Battle Damage Control Systems, exposure to Setting to Work (STW)/Harbour Acceptance Trials (HAT)/Sea Acceptance Trials (SAT), and prior experience handling Naval Inspectors or Classification Societies such as IRS, ABS, DNV, and LRS. The upper age limit is 32 years as on 01.08.2026, along with the required 12 months of cumulative post-qualification relevant work experience. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Project Engineer Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process for BHEL Project Engineer Recruitment 2026 is as follows: If the number of eligible applicants for a post is up to 1:10 of the number of vacancies, Personal Interviews will be conducted for all eligible candidates. If the number of eligible applicants exceeds the 1:10 ratio, the number of candidates called for Personal Interview will be restricted based on the aggregate marks obtained in the qualifying examination (Degree). The engagement is purely on a Fixed Tenure Basis and is not against any permanent vacancy. It does not entitle any candidate to claim regular or permanent employment with BHEL in the future. content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online only through edn.bhel.com or careers.bhel.in. Fill in the online application form and pay the applicable fee (if any) online through SBI Collect. Enter the bank receipt/journal number in the application form. Send the printed application form, along with the fee receipt (wherever applicable), to: "AGM (HR), Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited, Electronics Division, P. B. No. 2606, Mysore Road, Bengaluru-560026", so as to reach latest by 27.08.2026. Superscribe the envelope as "Application for Appointment as Project Engineer on Fixed Tenure Basis- DABG". Documents such as the Class X certificate for date of birth, category certificates (EWS/SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/Ex-servicemen), mark sheets, additional qualification proof, CGPA conversion proof, and experience certificates with salary slips are required only at the time of interview, if called for. BHEL is not responsible for any postal loss or delay in receipt of applications.
